english: In the case of the Vedic rituals, though it has been declared that "the Darśapūrṇamāsa sacrifices are conducive to all results, the Jyotiṣṭoma is conducive to all results," yet, from the very nature of persons undertaking the performance of these rites, the term "all" in this declaration is taken as standing only for all those results that have been declared as following from these sacrifices, and not actually all results in the literal sense of the term.
